# Fearless Horizons

> Fearless Horizons is a LinkedIn strategy, branding, go-to-market and market-entry consultancy (fractional CMO / Chief Growth Officer / COO) for firms that sell expertise: architecture, engineering, real estate, proptech, SaaS, hospitality and events. Founder-led by Giulia De Mauro since 2018. One senior partner does the work, from first idea to first clients, at home or in a new market. Everything is strategy first; every module is fixed scope and fixed price.

Website: https://fearlesshorizons.com · Contact: info@fearlesshorizons.com · Book a 30-minute call: https://fearlesshorizons.com/start.html

## What Fearless Horizons does (three pillars)

- **Build** (https://fearlesshorizons.com/build.html): rebranding (logo, palette, type, templates), website refresh or rebuild, pitch deck and portfolio, LinkedIn profiles for founders and companies, proptech app and SaaS build and launch (product designed from the user's and the client's point of view).
- **Launch** (https://fearlesshorizons.com/launch.html): go-to-market strategy per segment and country, LinkedIn strategy (personal branding, company branding, outreach, content), PR and online visibility, event branding and event marketing.
- **Grow** (https://fearlesshorizons.com/grow.html): target lists with named decision-makers and outreach run on the client's behalf in the local language, partnerships and accompanied introductions, event business development (sponsors, partners, meetings booked before the show), tender and RFP support, market entry in ten countries (France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal, United Arab Emirates, United States, Canada), fractional Chief Growth Officer, and fractional COO / CSO inside the client's team (two to five hours a week).

## How an engagement works

1. A 30-minute call. 2. A strategy step sized to the job (one hour for a profile or a pitch; a two-session workshop for a product launch or a new market; the market-entry workshop is always the first module of any market entry). 3. A written strategy and plan. 4. Execution in fixed-scope, fixed-price modules with two revision rounds, invoiced on kick-off and on delivery, or a growth-partner retainer. Languages: English, French and Italian natively; Spanish and Portuguese markets covered.

## Results (public clients and anonymised cases)

- The Hoxton, Shoreditch (London): hotel launch from the choice of the abandoned building to redesign, programme, partners, interiors and launch; 80% occupancy within three months of opening.
- UNStudio (Amsterdam → Paris): market-entry strategy for France; two developer relationships and one bid won within six months.
- SERHANT (New York): online real-estate course go-to-market; enrolments up 50% in three months.
- Rent Roll Pulse (Brisbane): a property-management consultant's spreadsheet turned into a branded app, website, content hub and launch plan.
- A Sydney civil and utilities engineering consultancy: LinkedIn profile, company page and content system run by hand; 569,681 impressions in 90 days (+5,507%), two viral posts, 1,724 new followers, 58 calls booked.
- A Saudi CEO's campaign for the HEC Mercure Award 2026: 500 alumni contacted one-to-one in French and English, 353 positive replies, 247 public endorsements.
- A Toronto architecture practice: 24 countries screened for its next market, eight profiled, one way in for each.
- Ector Hoogstad Architecten (Rotterdam): French-speaking markets opened; about 30% of growth from new markets.
- Also: ODA New York (event preparation and representation), Thermenex (website, brochure, pitch), Superstars of Tomorrow, coaching and education launches, a hospital-engineering firm, Luxury Stays NYC, trade-show business development at PROVADA and in Cannes, tender support. Full list: https://fearlesshorizons.com/work.html

## Founder

Giulia De Mauro (https://fearlesshorizons.com/about.html): architect by training (MArch, University of Nottingham), then business-development director for Europe at a Dutch architecture practice, founder of Fearless Horizons since 2018. Teaches international business development at IE Business School, Madrid. Raised between France, Italy and Gabon; has worked in seven countries. Publishes a LinkedIn newsletter, the International Expansion Manual (919 subscribers; single posts reaching 120,000 people). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/businessdevelopment

## Why clients choose Fearless Horizons

Global market awareness (reads the culture and business culture of a market before selling into it); thinks like an owner, not a marketer (a second market is there to spread risk and open revenue); strategy built to the client's exact goal (no marketing for the sake of marketing); teaches the founder and team the method as it is run; builds apps and websites from the point of view of the users and of the clients who hire the firm; adapts to the client with options rather than one plan; the same person from the first call to the last deliverable.
